Sasha L.: Heads-up — after the NCCL 4.0.0-rc1 rollout to ap-southeast GPUs we're seeing sporadic multi-GPU hangs on inference pods (A100s, nvlink enabled). first repro at 06:22 UTC. :eyes:
Mike H.: ugh, saw increased allreduce tail latency on the canaries, any p2p errors in dmesg?
Sasha L.: yes, some kernel logs: ```NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, GPU has fallen off the bus``` then repeated nccl errors about peer connect timeouts.
Alex P.: which driver/kernel combo? we just pushed driver 535.86 + kernel 6.5 to that fleet earlier today.
Sasha L.: driver 535.86, kernel 6.5.1-rc, NCCL 4.0.0-rc1. Symptoms: long stalls during allreduce, KVS handshake times out, then collectives hang until pod restart.
Jen C.: can we still route inference traffic to fallback region while we triage? capacity is tight but we can throttle non-critical customers.
Mike H.: routing plan: shift 30% of steady inference to eu-west1 and leave 70% on current. will need a config change in smart-router.

Sasha L.: repro steps I've used (short): ```kubectl exec -it pod-xyz -- ./collective_test --gpus 4 --iter 500 --model tiny```. Repro rate ~1/6 runs.
Alex P.: possible causes: NCCL 4 changed handshake semantics for p2p on nvlink + driver edge case. Also kernel 6.5 changed PCIe error recovery timing. Could be race.
Mike H.: quick mitigations: 1) pause full rollout, 2) pin NCCL to 3.9 for the fleet where we're seeing failures, 3) enable aggressive connection backoff in runtime (NCCL_SOCKET_RETRY=5). Thoughts?
Jen C.: pinning to 3.9 seems safest short-term. Pinning will increase token cost slightly because of perf delta but OK. Ops: create a rollback rotation for ap-southeast starting now.
Sasha L.: I agree. I'll prepare an automated canary roll back to NCCL 3.9 and add an env override `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` as an experiment on a small subset to see if nvlink p2p is the trigger.
Alex P.: also add `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` and capture traces; if p2p-disable works, we have a clear root cause. If not, we may need a kernel/drv hotfix.
